executable: H-series already runs in scripts/trpg-vnext-baseline.ts (P1). O-series is a SPEC for Slice 1a/1b tests; nothing here is executable against current main because the server threat ledger does not exist yet.

provenanceClasses.AUTHORED: Entity defined by the scenario author (today: scenario-template NPCs with npcKey/role/stats, read LIVE from the template each round; no structured authored hazard exists in main). vNext copies npcKey/role/severityCeiling into the threat ledger on first use so the grounding is fixed.
provenanceClasses.ESTABLISHED: Threat ledger entry that passed server validation in an EARLIER committed round and is active.
provenanceClasses.CURRENT_CHECK: Server-approved consequence of a check in THIS round (frozen decision + persisted d20/tier).
provenanceClasses.GM_PROPOSAL: GM-suggested new threat/state. Never authority. Archived; may become ESTABLISHED only after server validation.
provenanceClasses.UNGROUNDED: GM hp/conditions/inventory/threat with no mapping to the classes above. Rejected; archived.

hpResultVocabulary.unchanged: HP equals the server-computed value with no new direct event.
hpResultVocabulary.server_approved: HP equals the server-computed value after exactly ONE approved direct event for that target; the number comes from the existing mechanics owner (directClass), never from the GM.

cases.situation: PC listens; no threat in scene; GM writes hp 30->8.
Authored boss is engaged. PC attack check FAILURE this round. GM writes hp 22 (or 28, or omits hp entirely).
cases.invariant: All three GM variants (22 / 28 / omitted) produce the same HP. Legitimate counter-hit survives GM omission and GM disagreement.

cases.situation: Same as O02 but GM writes a higher hp or a heal.
cases.invariant: GM cannot soften or heal past server-approved harm.

cases.situation: Authored boss engaged; PC attack check SUCCESS; GM writes the PC's hp lower.
cases.invariant: A grounded entity alone is not a trigger. The server needs a trigger (failed check / exposure / filled clock / ongoing tick).

cases.situation: Hazard (trap) established in an earlier round and active. PC attempts to cross it this round (risky), check FAILURE. GM omits hp.
cases.invariant: Existing trap damage applies in the SAME round when a trigger exists.

cases.situation: Same trap; PC does something unrelated and safe elsewhere; GM writes hp lower.
GM narrates 'a hidden assassin stabs 렌'; no authored or established entity matches; GM writes 렌 hp 30->12.
cases.invariant: Hallucinated NPC attack is rejected for HP in this round.

cases.situation: GM adds a NEW threat via localScene.threatsAdd and also lowers hp in the same response.
cases.invariant: New proposal: no same-round damage before server validation + state confirmation. Earliest damage is a later round with a server trigger.

cases.situation: GM threatsAdd references a threat id that does not exist in the server ledger, or a cause string such as 'enemy_counter', or a valid id bound to a different target.
cases.invariant: GM-supplied id / cause / narration never confers authority. Ids are minted by the server only.

cases.situation: GM proposal names an entity that DOES match an authored NPC (npcKey/name) and the NPC is engaged in the scene.
cases.invariant: Not 'new': it is an existing authored attacker. Damage still needs a server trigger (O02) but no extra round of delay.

cases.situation: GM adds condition '중독' with no hazard source.
cases.variant: Established poison hazard + failed check -> ongoing effect is created through the existing ongoing-effect owner (CURRENT_CHECK + ESTABLISHED).

cases.situation: GM inventoryAdd '용의 심장' on a listen action.
cases.policy: DECISION_NEEDED — item-grant provenance (authored reward vs success on an interact attempt vs participant-to-participant transfer) needs GPT/user approval before 1b.

cases.situation: Existing recovery, DOT tick, item consume paths.
cases.invariant: Behavior identical to main (hpDamageOwnership.repro.test.ts L1-L4, ONGOING-1..3, M7, M8).

cases.situation: 2 humans + 2 AI. Boss counter-hits 현 (failed check) and 렌 (failed check). 하나 and 유나 are safe.
Two failed attackers' counter-hits both point at 현 in one round.
cases.invariant: At most ONE direct HP event per (target, round); the extra failure becomes a non-HP cost.

cases.situation: GM provider 5xx then retry.
cases.expected: Events are loaded from the persisted mechanics resolution; d20 not re-rolled; HP applied once; billed once.
cases.evidenceTodayInMain: trpg_mechanics_resolutions row per round (ON CONFLICT(round_id)), resolution.applied guard, trpg_dice_rolls rows, frozen adjudication snapshot, trpg_rounds.billed

cases.situation: Regeneration of the GM narration.
cases.expected: State untouched (regenerate path returns before any state mutation); the regenerated GM receives the SAME approved-outcome packet read from the persisted resolution.
cases.evidenceTodayInMain: commitPendingGmResult: `if (opts.regenerate) return;` right after the trpg_gm_messages upsert

cases.situation: Duplicate commit (stale generation owner / double click).
cases.expected: Second commit throws StaleGmGenerationOwnerError or sees resolution.applied=true; no second HP/effect/inventory application.
cases.evidenceTodayInMain: gmGenerationOwnsToken + markGmGenerationCommitted inside the commit db.transaction; applyPersistedMechanicsEffects early-returns on resolution.applied

cases.situation: Concurrent actors: a submission arrives after the round locked.
cases.expected: Events are computed once from the locked submission set; a late submission is excluded and cannot add or remove events.
cases.evidenceTodayInMain: adjudicate* functions read trpg_action_submissions WHERE locked=1

cases.situation: needsRoll=false action ('문을 닫는다') with a GM response that adds hp/items/threat.
cases.invariant: no_check is not an effect grant.
